lines: Obsession beats discipline. Until it sends the bill.
Obsession is the engine. Discipline is the seatbelt.
Price one. Sleep. Stay awake long enough, and you perform like you are over the drink limit.
Price two. Your body. Fifty-five hour weeks raise stroke risk by about thirty-five percent.
Price three. People. They leave one unanswered message at a time.
Price four. Who you are. When it is everything, losing it feels like losing yourself.
So build the leash. A sleep floor. One sacred appointment. A body check. A kill switch. An off ramp.
Obsession is a fire. Build the fireplace. The full film is on the channel.
